# Instagram Reel scripts (15–30 s)

Film only real printed pages and the real cut-out cards. Do not show products, packaging or bindings that customers do not receive.
On-screen disclaimer for every reel: "Digital download – you print at home."

## Reel 1 – "From printer to playtime" (assembly)
| Time | Shot | On-screen text | Voice-over |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0–3 s | Printer feeding out the cover (p1) | From printer… | "From printer…" |
| 3–7 s | Adult hands cutting card RD1 on sheet p41 with scissors | Grown-ups cut along the solid lines | "…grown-ups cut along the solid lines…" |
| 7–11 s | Cards dropped into an envelope labelled "Sheet 1" | Store each sheet in an envelope | "…keep every sheet in its own envelope…" |
| 11–16 s | Optional: laminated card + reusable dot pressed onto a dotted-circle spot | Laminating = optional | "…laminate if you like…" |
| 16–22 s | Child's hands placing drops on Rainbow Rescue (p5), adult beside | …to playtime! | "…to playtime!" |
| 22–25 s | Cover + "Ages 3–5 with adult supervision" | My Magic Busy Book · printable PDF | — |

## Reel 2 – "Watch this little mission come to life" (Mission 14, Count the Balloons)
| Time | Shot | On-screen text |
|---|---|---|
| 0–3 s | Close-up of p18, empty boxes | Mission 14: Count the Balloons |
| 3–10 s | Finger touching each balloon in the bunch of 4, counting aloud | 1… 2… 3… 4! |
| 10–15 s | Number card NU4 placed in the box under the bunch | Find the number card |
| 15–22 s | Speed-up of the remaining five bunches being completed | 2 · 4 · 1 · 5 · 3 · 6 |
| 22–26 s | Child colours the "I did it!" star | Mission complete! |
